items.title: Deterministic matching

items.title: Audit export

sections.heading: Why we built it
sections.body: Our founders ran finance operations at two marketplaces and spent every month-end rebuilding the same reconciliation workbook. The tooling that existed either assumed a single processor or expected an implementation consultant and a six-month rollout. Ledgerloop takes the opposite position: connect a processor, import last month's ledger, and see your first matched period the same afternoon. The matching engine is deterministic by design because finance teams cannot defend a number they cannot reproduce, so we never use a model to decide whether two amounts are the same transaction. Models help us rank suggestions in the exception queue, and a person still approves every posting.

items.question: How long does implementation take?
items.answer: Most teams reconcile their first period within a day. Connecting a processor takes minutes, and importing historical ledger data is a single CSV or an API sync.

items.question: Do you write to our accounting system automatically?
items.answer: Only after a person approves the entry. You can require one or two approvers per journal, and every posting records who approved it and when.

items.question: Where is our data stored?
items.answer: In EU or US regions of your choosing, encrypted at rest and in transit. Processor credentials are stored encrypted and are never exposed in the interface or exports.

items.question: Is there an audit trail?
items.answer: Every match, unmatch, rule change, and approval is appended to an immutable log with actor, timestamp, and the rule version in force at the time.

items.question: What happens when we exceed our plan volume?
items.answer: Nothing breaks. We bill overage at the plan rate and email you when you cross 80 percent of your allowance so you can move tiers deliberately.

items.question: Can we cancel mid-term?
items.answer: Monthly plans cancel at the end of the current period. Annual plans can be cancelled for the following term, and your audit archives stay exportable for 90 days.

items.question: Is the trial limited?
items.answer: The 14-day trial includes every Growth feature and caps at 25,000 transactions. No card is required to begin.

items.question: Do you offer annual discounts?
items.answer: Yes, two months free on annual prepayment for Starter and Growth, and negotiated terms on Scale and Enterprise.

items.question: Which currencies can we pay in?
items.answer: GBP, EUR, and USD by card or bank transfer. Enterprise contracts can be invoiced in other currencies on request.
